purpose: Prevent aggregate consensus changes from being mislabeled as same-forecaster analyst revisions.
prerequisites: stable forecaster identity or deduplication key
identical fiscal horizon and forecast basis
frozenDiagnostics: actual consensus delta using provider-eligible active population
fixed-membership consensus delta among continuing forecasters
providerPolicyFirewall: Provider consensus inclusion/exclusion policy is part of the data-generating process and must be versioned when known.
Do not import another provider's stale cutoff; documented provider policies vary materially.
A consensus jump caused only by provider suppression, analyst entry/exit, basis exclusion or horizon roll is not SAME_FORECASTER_REVISION.
If provider eligibility history is unavailable, suppression/composition attribution is UNATTRIBUTABLE_UNKNOWN.
counterevidence: Published provider comparisons document materially different stale-estimate and eligibility rules, so vendor consensus levels are not definition-free substitutes.
Analyst-composition changes can alter measured consensus accuracy and level even without identical-analyst belief changes.
Forecast dispersion can reflect information diversity as well as uncertainty; it is context, not an automatic bearish score.
forwardPEFirewall: Persist price and forecast EPS separately.
Keep CURRENT_FY, NEXT_FY and NTM separate.
Decompose changes into price, continuing-forecaster EPS revision, membership/provider-eligibility, correction/supersession and horizon roll.
Forward-PE compression alone is not a bullish improvement.
falsification: If fixed-membership revision loses the apparent effect seen in raw consensus delta, classify raw effect as composition-sensitive.
If results depend on one provider eligibility rule or stale policy, mark provider-definition fragile.
If source lineage or membership history is incomplete, fail closed to UNKNOWN.
